drhp.business: The Company manufactures, lays and joints pipelines (RCC, Steel, Prestressed Concrete, Penstock, Bar Wrapped Steel Cylinder, Prestressed Concrete Cylinder) and executes turnkey EPC water-supply, irrigation, sanitation and sewerage projects for Central/State Governments and local bodies across India, including full-system works such as intake wells, treatment plants, pumping stations and reservoirs; it also supplies concrete railway sleepers to Indian Railways. Since FY2023-24 it has added a land-development segment that monetizes the Company's own land parcels via real-estate projects.

risks.note: Management flagged increased competition from larger construction players as a threat to the Company's water-supply/pipeline construction business.
Availability of substitute pipe materials such as Ductile Iron pipes, spirally welded steel pipes and HDPE pipes is cited as a competitive threat to the Company's own pipe product mix.
Prices of key raw materials - steel, steel wires, HT wires and cement - were on an uptrend during the year, which can pressure margins on fixed-price EPC/supply contracts.

The West Asia geopolitical conflict (US-Iran) has intensified global energy-market uncertainty and raised crude oil prices, increasing costs of oil, bought-out items and transportation and thereby raising overall project costs.

The Wadala (Mumbai) SRA project and the Badarpur (New Delhi) land are still at the initial stage of obtaining development-related approvals; realizing value from these land parcels depends on navigating regulatory frameworks and market dynamics, creating timing/execution uncertainty for this newer segment.
